text:
Type: hanging metal planter with chains
Use: hanging a trailing plant from a ceiling hook or a bracket; living room, kitchen, balcony
Style: farmhouse, bohemian, traditional
Materials: powder-coated steel with a lace-like perforated rim, metal chains, S hook
Colors: soft off-white, silver grey chains
Shape: rounded conical pot with a scalloped crown-shaped rim, hangs from three thin chains joined at a hook, compact and light
Feel: romantic, charming, airy, delicate
Goes with: trailing green plants, white walls, light wood, rattan; farmhouse, cottage or bohemian rooms
